'''Hunter-killer war droids''' were used by the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The droids were deployed against the [[Hero of Tython]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
